name: opencrabs
description: The all-in-one AI agent living in your terminal. Build landing, mobile apps, backends, manages files, deep research, schedule tasks and events. Self-improving, self-healing, fully autonomous. TUI, CLI and Daemon. Connect to your favorite channels.
summary: 终端内全栈 AI 代理。构建着陆页、移动应用、后端，管理文件，进行深度研究，安排任务与事件。自我进化、自我修复、完全自主。支持 TUI、CLI 和守护进程。连接您的 favorite channels
